points.title: 童年启蒙
points.description: 白居易出生于河南新郑的一个官僚家庭，祖父曾任巩县令。幼年时期，白居易展现出非凡的文学天赋，5岁开始学诗，9岁能作诗。然而，他的童年并不平静，因安史之乱后的动荡，家庭曾迁居各地。这一时期，他接受了良好的儒家教育，奠定了深厚的文化基础，同时也目睹了战乱给百姓带来的苦难，这成为他后来创作现实主义诗歌的重要源泉。
points.descriptionEn: Bai Juyi was born in Xinzheng, Henan to an official family. His grandfather served as the magistrate of Gong County. Showing exceptional literary talent from a young age, Bai began learning poetry at 5 and could compose poems by 9. His childhood was not peaceful due to the turmoil after the An Lushan Rebellion, forcing his family to relocate multiple times. During this period, he received a solid Confucian education, laying a profound cultural foundation, while also witnessing the hardships inflicted upon common people by war, which later became an important source for his realistic poetry.

points.title: 求学应试
points.description: 16岁时，白居易来到当时的政治文化中心长安，开始了他的求学之路。他刻苦攻读，博览群书，尤其擅长诗歌创作。贞元十六年（800年），白居易中进士，步入仕途。这一时期，他创作了大量诗歌，形成了自己独特的风格，以通俗易懂、贴近生活著称。他在长安结识了许多文人墨客，如元稹等人，建立了深厚的友谊，共同推动了新乐府运动的发展。
points.descriptionEn: At 16, Bai Juyi came to Chang'an, the political and cultural center of the time, beginning his academic journey. He studied diligently, extensively reading various books, and excelled in poetry composition. In 800, he passed the imperial examination and entered officialdom. During this period, he wrote numerous poems, developing his unique style characterized by accessibility and relevance to daily life. In Chang'an, he befriended many scholars like Yuan Zhen, establishing deep friendships and jointly promoting the development of the New Yuefu movement.

points.title: 地方任职
points.description: 白居易先后在盩厔县、翰林院等地担任地方官。这一时期，他深入民间，了解百姓疾苦，创作了大量反映社会现实的诗歌，如《卖炭翁》、《观刈麦》等。元和十年（815年），因上书言事得罪权贵，被贬为江州司马。这一挫折使白居易更加关注民生疾苦，诗歌创作更加注重社会批判性。他的诗歌语言通俗易懂，内容贴近生活，被誉为'老妪能解'，体现了他的文学理念——诗歌应当为大众所理解，反映社会现实。
points.descriptionEn: Bai Juyi successively served as local officials in Zhouchi County and the Hanlin Academy. During this period, he immersed himself in local communities, understanding the hardships of common people, and wrote numerous poems reflecting social reality, such as 'The Charcoal Seller' and 'Watching the Harvesting of Wheat.' In 815, he was demoted to Jiangzhou司马 after offending powerful officials with his memorials. This setback made Bai even more concerned with people's livelihoods, and his poetry became more socially critical. His accessible language and life-related content earned him the praise that 'even old women could understand his poems,' reflecting his literary philosophy that poetry should be comprehensible to the masses and reflect social reality.

points.title: 贬谪创作
points.description: 被贬江州期间，白居易经历了人生的重要转折。虽然政治上失意，但他在文学创作上达到了新的高度。这一时期，他创作了著名的《琵琶行》，通过琵琶女的遭遇抒发自己的政治失意和对人生的感悟。同时，他继续创作了大量反映社会现实的诗歌，如《长恨歌》等。江州的生活使白居易更加深入地了解了民间疾苦，他的诗歌创作更加成熟，形成了自己独特的风格，对后世产生了深远影响。
points.descriptionEn: During his exile in Jiangzhou, Bai Juyi experienced a significant turning point in his life. Although politically frustrated, he reached new heights in literary creation. During this period, he wrote the famous 'Pipa Xing' (The Song of the Pipa), expressing his political frustrations and reflections on life through the story of a pipa player. He continued to write numerous poems reflecting social reality, such as 'Song of Everlasting Regret.' Life in Jiangzhou allowed Bai to gain a deeper understanding of people's hardships, making his poetry more mature and forming his unique style that had a profound influence on later generations.

points.title: 地方治理
points.description: 长庆二年（822年），白居易被任命为杭州刺史。在杭州任职期间，他兴修水利，疏浚西湖，修建堤坝，解决了当地的水患问题，改善了百姓生活。他还重视教育，兴办学校，培养人才。这一时期，白居易的诗歌创作更加注重实用性，反映了他的政治理念和社会关怀。他的治理措施使杭州面貌焕然一新，深受百姓爱戴。离任时，百姓纷纷挽留，甚至有人为他建祠纪念。白居易在杭州的治理成就，体现了他'兼济天下'的政治理想。
points.descriptionEn: In 822, Bai Juyi was appointed as the prefect of Hangzhou. During his tenure, he initiated water conservancy projects, dredged West Lake, and built dams to solve local flooding problems and improve people's lives. He also emphasized education, establishing schools and cultivating talent. During this period, Bai's poetry became more practical, reflecting his political philosophy and social concerns. His governance measures transformed Hangzhou, earning him deep respect from the people. Upon his departure, residents pleaded for him to stay, and some even built temples in his memory. Bai's achievements in Hangzhou embodied his political ideal of 'serving the world'.

points.title: 晚年归隐
points.description: 晚年，白居易定居洛阳，过着半官半隐的生活。他担任太子少傅等闲职，逐渐远离政治中心。这一时期，他创作了大量闲适诗和感怀诗，如《琵琶行》的续作《琵琶引》等。白居易晚年生活简朴，与友人诗酒唱和，修身养性。他整理了自己的诗集，编纂了《白氏长庆集》，收录了自己一生的诗歌创作。会昌六年（846年），白居易在洛阳逝世，享年75岁。他的诗歌作品流传千古，成为中国文学史上的瑰宝，对后世文学产生了深远影响。
points.descriptionEn: In his later years, Bai Juyi settled in Luoyang, living a semi-retired life while holding honorary positions like Grand Tutor to the Crown Prince, gradually distancing himself from the political center. During this period, he wrote numerous leisure poems and reflective works, including the sequel to 'Pipa Xing' titled 'Pipa Yin'. Bai lived a simple life in his later years, enjoying poetry, wine, and cultivation with friends. He compiled his collected poems into 'Bai's Changqing Collection', encompassing his lifetime of poetic creation. In 846, Bai Juyi passed away in Luoyang at the age of 75. His poetic works have been passed down through generations, becoming treasures in Chinese literary history and exerting profound influence on later literature.

supporter.zh: 白居易被誉为'诗魔'和'诗王'，是中国文学史上伟大的现实主义诗人。他的诗歌通俗易懂，贴近生活，反映了唐代社会的方方面面，尤其是普通百姓的疾苦。他倡导'文章合为时而著，歌诗合为事而作'的文学理念，强调诗歌的社会功能。作为地方官，他兴修水利，重视教育，切实改善民生，体现了'兼济天下'的儒家理想。白居易的诗歌不仅艺术成就高，而且具有深刻的社会意义，对后世文学产生了深远影响。
supporter.en: Bai Juyi is revered as the 'Poetic Devil' and 'Poetic King', a great realist poet in Chinese literary history. His accessible and life-related poems reflect various aspects of Tang Dynasty society, especially the hardships of common people. He advocated the literary principle that 'articles should be written for the times and poems should be composed for events', emphasizing the social function of poetry. As a local official, he initiated water conservancy projects, valued education, and improved people's livelihoods, embodying the Confucian ideal of 'serving the world'. Bai's poems not only achieve high artistic standards but also possess profound social significance, exerting far-reaching influence on later literature.

critic.zh: 批评者认为白居易的诗歌过于直白，缺乏含蓄之美，艺术成就不及李白、杜甫等唐代大诗人。在政治上，他虽然关心民生，但未能坚持自己的政治理想，多次因言获罪而被贬谪，显示出政治上的软弱。此外，白居易晚年诗歌多闲适之作，缺乏早期的批判精神，被一些评论家视为'退步'。他的诗歌虽然通俗易懂，但有时过于直白，缺乏艺术上的深度和复杂性，这也是一些文学批评者对他的主要批评点。
critic.en: Critics argue that Bai Juyi's poetry is too straightforward, lacking the subtlety and beauty of more reserved works, and that his artistic achievements do not match those of great Tang poets like Li Bai and Du Fu. Politically, although he cared about people's livelihood, he failed to uphold his ideals and was repeatedly demoted for his outspokenness, showing political weakness. Furthermore, his later poems are mostly leisure works, lacking the critical spirit of his early period, which some critics view as a 'regression'. While his poetry is accessible, it can be overly direct, lacking the depth and complexity valued in art, which is a major point of criticism from some literary scholars.

objective.zh: 从历史学角度看，白居易是唐代中期重要的政治家和文学家，他的诗歌作品不仅是文学瑰宝，也是研究唐代社会历史的重要史料。在流行文化中，白居易常被塑造为关心民生的清官形象，他的诗歌被广泛传颂，成为中国文化的重要组成部分。白居易的文学理念和实践对中国文学发展产生了深远影响，他倡导的'新乐府运动'推动了现实主义文学的发展。他的诗歌作品跨越时空，至今仍被人们传诵和研究，体现了中国古典文学的永恒魅力。
objective.en: From a historical perspective, Bai Juyi was an important statesman and writer in the mid-Tang Dynasty. His poetic works are not only literary treasures but also valuable historical materials for studying Tang society. In popular culture, Bai is often portrayed as an upright official concerned with people's welfare, and his poems are widely celebrated as an essential part of Chinese culture. Bai's literary philosophy and practice have had a profound impact on Chinese literature development; the 'New Yuefu Movement' he advocated promoted the development of realistic literature. His works have transcended time and space, still being recited and studied today, reflecting the eternal charm of classical Chinese literature.

self.zh: 文章合为时而著，歌诗合为事而作。
self.en: Poetry should be written for the times and composed for events.

others.zh: 白乐天诗，老妪能解，然失之浅近。
others.en: Bai Letian's poetry can be understood by old women, but it lacks depth and subtlety.
